scope: Same-read comparison to the complete-CDS SERPINA2 mRNA from the 2013 functional study. Transcript coordinate spans are not genomic fragment lengths; this is sequence identity evidence, not physical locus or transcript-expression proof.
reference_selection: ENA exact-gene human sequence search returned one record, JX680599. Its EMBL metadata cites PMID 23826168, testes mRNA and Sanger sequencing; 1266 bp complete CDS. Selected after the AL117259.6 clone comparison failed to improve mapping.
interpretation_limit: BWA is not a splice-aware transcript-to-genome alignment here. Pair-span and genome alignment fields are descriptive algorithm output, not genomic insert-size, physical-origin or expression evidence.
